radiusSource: Radius 13.491 (12.225 to 14.703) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 9,385,837 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 3.384 (3.343 to 3.488) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 6557174816171322624: teff_gspphot 5763.226 K (16th-84th percentiles 5757.0884-5769.158), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 6557174816171322624: teff_gspphot 5763.226 K (16th-84th percentiles 5757.0884-5769.158), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
